    Quick guide

    1. Play the original and listen for the reveal. Choose its caption in the timeline.
    2. Select the first word to hold back. Pause on the spoken reveal and choose Use playhead, or enter the time.
    3. Apply the fix, then replay the caption in Original and Edited to compare. Check that the delayed words stay readable.
    4. Export SRT to bring the edited captions into your video editor.
